summary: Angel Oak Mortgage REIT filed an 8-K reporting that on September 25, 2026, it and two subsidiaries extended their master repurchase loan financing facility with a lender (Global Investment Bank 3) through September 25, 2027, and reduced the interest-rate pricing spread to a range of 1.35% to 4.75% from 1.75% to 4.75%. The Sixth Amendment to the Second Amended and Restated Master Repurchase Agreement is attached as Exhibit 10.1, with portions redacted under Item 601(b)(10)(iv). No board recommendation, advisor, securities issuance, or change of control is involved; this is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation.
